title: [HIGH SEVERITY VULNERABILITY] `instantsearch.js` should use `qs@^6.14.1` instead of `^6.5.1 < 6.10`
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

Currently, in `packages/instantsearch.js/package.json`, there is:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "qs": "^6.5.1 < 6.10"
  }
}
```

But with `qs <6.14.1`, there's a high severity vulnerability:
[qs's arrayLimit bypass in its bracket notation allows DoS via memory exhaustion](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6rw7-vpxm-498p)

This vulnerability was fixed in patched version `6.14.1`.

I hope there's no reason to have `< 6.10`.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

When installing:
- `react-instantsearch@latest` _(currently `7.22.0`)_
- or `instantsearch.js@latest` _(currently `4.86.0`)_

`npm i` or `npm audit` will display the high severity vulnerabilities in the console.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/templates/react-instantsearch

### 💭 Expected behavior

- No `high severity vulnerabilities` should appear in the console when installing `react-instantsearch@latest`
- In instantsearch.js `package.json`, there should be: `"qs": "^6.14.1"`

### Package version

`instantsearch.js@4.86.0` _(via `react-instantsearch@7.22.0`)_

### Operating system

_No response_

_No response_

comments.body:
I can see how this being marked as an official vulnerability requires us to change the version of qs.

Note however that this has a 10k bundlesize penalty, and is the original reason why we added the limitation of not 6.10 of qs.

I've made PR https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6850 to fix this. In the mean time you can force the resolution of qs to 6.14.1, it won't break InstantSearch.

@Haroenv Thanks for:
- the merged PR
- the precision about the 10K bundle size penalty _(I've never heard of `bundlesize` before, I think I'll start using this package)_

### Note:

About forcing the resolution of `qs` to `6.14.1`, "great minds think alike" 😉 It's exactly what I did just after I opened this issue
_(see this commit 12h ago: [build(package.json): 📌 🔒 use qs@6.14.1 to avoid vulnerabilities](https://github.com/gauthieramano/next-go/commit/83bf72659863e6951c1aaf35e2b9b67873982001))_
as:
- I saw that nothing broke in the search
- I assumed there was no breaking change _(as no minor upgrade is supposed to introduce any)_
Thanks for confirming. The proper release is in progress
